adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper does not “swallow” parse failures: it calls `safeParse` and explicitly `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous `console.error(...)` block was removed, but the new code will throw on malformed Microsoft token responses rather than silently continuing and persisting stale/partial credentials. The finding’s core claim (silent persistence + swallowed failure) is not supported by the diff.
